summary: 1965 metal cab on St. Peter's Dome replacing a 1932 L-4 ground house; unstaffed by 2020 after the 1996 Dome Fire and a 2001 re-burn, now a communications site; NHLR-registered 2022.

facts.design: CL-100 to CL-106 series metal 14x14-foot R6 flat-top cab with metal catwalk on a 10-foot cinder block base with storage room (register)

access.note: The register describes the lookout as an unstaffed communications site. No current visitor rules appear in the sources read. A 2016 hike notice describes a 4.5-mile approach on FS Road 142, a 4WD road, from FS Road 289 (Dome Road).

visit.trail_note: 2016 hike notice: 4.5 miles along FS Road 142 from its junction with FS Road 289 (Dome Road), on a 4WD road; no current route information found

events.note: L-4 ground house, dated 1932 by the register; replaced in 1965
Five rangers snowbound in November 1940; the Dome Lookout Station where the storm caught them was well provisioned, per a newspaper item quoted by West Lookouts
Standard Plan metal cab with metal catwalk on a 10-foot cinder block base with storage room, replacing the 1932 L-4 ground house
Dome Fire broke out April 26, 1996 from an improperly extinguished campfire and burned 16,516 acres; the register cites it as one reason the lookout is now a communications site
Las Conchas Fire re-burned the site; the register cites it with the 1996 fire and vandalism
Report says the lookout is currently unstaffed and used as a communications site
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register on May 22, 2022

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register ties the communications-site use to the 1996 fire, vandalism and the 2001 re-burn. The 2020 report repeats the same reasons. No conflict found; the sources agree.

notes_for_editor: Access is marked restricted as an editorial judgement: the register calls it an unstaffed communications site and no current visitor rules were found; the only approach description is a 2016 hike notice. The brief's access 'unknown' and staffing gap are filled from the 2020 report; there is no staffing source after 2020. The brief's height is not in any source read, so none is given. The 1940 item is quoted through West Lookouts, which names the paper as 'Arizona Independent Republic'; the paper name was not checked against a scan. The Zinn history PDF cited in the register (fs.usda.gov fseprd542352.pdf) returned HTTP 404 and was not used. No photos added.
